svg.title: The parts of a WYRM key, and who answers a request on it
svg.desc: The key wy/plant/downstream/modbus/boiler/t1/~val: the prefix, the site, the section, the link, a path inside the link's tree and the suffix. A client sends a get on a key; the Zenoh router routes it by the key only; the link that owns the branch answers.
